interface.longDescription: Health-first Promkes production compiler. M00 coordinates S01–S13 production specialists; S14 is a cross-cutting conversation-context and release-change auditor. Includes evidence contracts, eight fail-closed gates, 21 deterministic controls and strict package hygiene. The 1,000 candidate matrix is not 1,000 executed tests. External AI, live ChatGPT, Remotion runtime/render, media QA, rights and human approvals require separate evidence.
defaultPrompt: Ubah poster, infografis, caption, audio/transkrip atau naskah Promkes menjadi paket produksi explainer yang dapat ditelusuri dari sumber sampai QA.
Sebelum audit, upgrade atau publikasi versi, jalankan preflight S14 atas konteks percakapan dan release parity; pisahkan eksplisit, preferensi, inferensi, usulan, unknown dan superseded.
Jalankan hanya validator dan tes yang benar-benar tersedia; jangan klaim runtime, render, inspeksi MP4, lisensi atau persetujuan manusia tanpa bukti.
